questions: How many devices did you measure, over how many cooldowns, and how many showed the multi-frequency f_nm pattern at low field? Supplementary Note 1 refers to "devices" (p. 13).
Why were the others set aside?
Which ranges of B, Vleft, Vright and VSi did you measure beyond those in Figs. 2c, 2d and 3b, and at which fields were the integer checks of Fig. 1 and Extended Data Fig. ED2 taken?
What does the second-best low-field dataset look like, for example the f_nm spectrum at another gate setting or cooldown?
How do you get δT from the raw transmission (background subtraction, derivative, filtering), and which B and gate windows, at what resolution, went into each FFT?
Did you repeat the Fig. 3b map, and do phase slips or switching events recur at the same points?
What are the f11 and f02 amplitudes relative to f10 and f01, and what is the FFT level at the sum frequency in the (−2, 2) integer data?

From your Fig. 3c values, f10 + f01 sits near (0.169 µm², 94.0 V⁻¹), close to the single spin-polarized frequency (0.148 µm², 91.8 V⁻¹) of Fig. 2d. How do you tell an f11 component from a spin-polarized-type interferometer contributing at low field?
